title: TRAK — master checklist

release.native: Regular TRAK Build 467 · iOS TestFlight internal beta · installed; cold Search and recipe History UAT affected
release.backend: Production remains build 2709 · staging now has the enforced Fast Search index and Raw Chicken portion correction
release.next: Retest the existing TRAK Staging Build 14. Catalogue and TRAK Custom results should no longer wait seconds behind local results, and Raw Chicken should show household portion chips. Phone acceptance remains open; regular TRAK and production are unchanged.

notes: Public, read-only project status. No login needed.
Historical checks are retained separately; a new regression is not closed by an older sign-off.
Updates appear here after the shared checklist is published. Local edits and chat messages do not update it.

changes.text: Staging Build 14 failed two new phone checks: catalogue and TRAK Custom results lagged behind local results, and Raw Chicken had no portion chips. The staging Fast index had not been enabled and the Custom Search response omitted reviewed source metadata. A backend-only correction is now healthy on staging and passes live timing and payload checks; the same installed staging app still needs phone acceptance. Production was not changed.

TRAK Staging Build 14 is available to internal testers. It combines the existing Cronometer nutrient work with the Search first-paint and stable-results correction, shared recipe servings and preserved AI recipe identity. The combined staging backend is healthy. Regular TRAK and production were not changed.

Installed regular Build 467 remains affected: a cold chicken breast Search took about two seconds, Previously logged and My foods could continue appearing afterward, and a recently logged recipe could lose its named serving and show grams. Staging Build 14 is the candidate correction, not a verified-live fix.

The food-projection audit now has an executable source-of-truth matrix, identical cross-path fixtures and parity tests. It confirmed that some secondary calorie consumers still bypass the canonical entries-versus-food-log daily-total rule; that remediation remains separate and open.

Build 464 is installed on iPhone and partially failed phone acceptance: the first Search open after updating still waited for Suggested and Recents; Food Editor changed shape after opening and did not update the Nutrition basis from the TRAK number pad; safe logout used a centred dialog; and Delete Undo waited for sync. Stay signed in passed. Local follow-up corrections are tested but are not in Build 464.

Typed Search was separately reported slow again on Build 464. No exact query or Fast-versus-Full timing has been captured, so this remains an open diagnosis and is not claimed fixed by the empty-Search shelf correction.

Build 464 was built and signed locally for iOS and Android from one tested source. It includes the Search and recurring cold-open corrections, exact serving-choice retention for pending or offline logs, and refined iPhone inactive-state diagnostics. It was subsequently uploaded to TestFlight and installed on iPhone; its partial phone results are recorded above.

The Build 463 missing-Recents issue is corrected in the live backend. Suggested habits no longer block recent non-habit foods from the current meal, and the shelves cannot duplicate a card. No new phone build is needed; close and reopen Search to verify.

New Search issue confirmed after installing Build 463: Suggested can appear while the Recents shelf is absent. Recents are currently narrowed to the clock slot, and their meal-period fallback is blocked whenever Suggested has a card.

Build 463 is valid in TRAK's internal TestFlight group and is now installed on iPhone. Its backend and database companion are live. The matching Android build is signed and Aadam is uploading it to Firebase. Recurring-transition and food-editor acceptance remain open.

Recurring transitions and the serving/unit/icon editor are implemented, combined and reviewed locally. Final tests pass: 3,717 native, 108 legacy-login and 630 backend tests. The three final review defects are repaired; one minor empty-panel metadata follow-up remains. Backend/schema release, a new phone build and device checks are still required. Not in Build 462.

Build 462 is available in TestFlight for internal testers; Apple processing and beta availability are verified. The matching Android file is ready for Firebase. Installation and phone acceptance remain open.

Main coordination checkpoint saved for a pause. Build 462 files and release notes are preserved. Resume with delivery and phone checks, address any remaining regression, then serving-size editing. Other work owners are unchanged.

Build 462 signed iPhone and Android files are ready and release tests pass. Includes Search opening, saved-library visibility, recurring refresh and safe logout. Upload, installation and phone acceptance remain; these issues are not marked resolved.
Search opening: a local native correction removes a disk-cache wait that can hold ready Suggested/Recents cards. A new phone build and timing check remain; the wider idle freeze is not closed.
Reconciled the latest handoff: copy work is paused; reference-food publication and source-inventory review remain open.
Published the shared, no-login master checklist with current issues, unreleased fixes and earlier sign-offs separated.
Deployed the upcoming-slot recurring correction; phone acceptance remains.
Search History and recurring additions confirmed working on phone.
Library filtering, recurring return refresh and safe logout corrected in the unreleased native candidate.

tasks.title: Recipes and custom foods appear missing
tasks.summary: The catalogue-filter correction is in regular TRAK and the saved records were confirmed present. The latest report concerns My foods arriving late inside Search, not deleted library data. Staging Build 14 carries the stable personal-results candidate, but full library acceptance remains open.
tasks.nextStep: On Staging Build 14, enter a catalogue query, open Recipes and Foods, and confirm both complete saved libraries appear immediately, remain loggable and are unaffected by the catalogue query. Do not reset or recreate existing data.

tasks.title: Offline and restart food-log recovery
tasks.summary: Build 464 kept an unsaved food after choosing Stay signed in and saved it after reconnecting, but delayed Delete Undo by roughly ten seconds. The local-admission correction is included in regular Build 467 and inherited by Staging Build 14; full connectivity-change and restart acceptance remains open.
tasks.nextStep: On Staging Build 14, repeat reconnect then immediate delete and confirm Undo appears immediately while sync continues. Also add, edit, move, copy and delete offline, reopen, and confirm the intended diary survives without duplication.

tasks.title: Recurring foods log at their exact local time
tasks.summary: Backend and scheduler are live. The native exact-time, cold-open, duplicate and transition safeguards are inherited by regular Build 467 and Staging Build 14, but open, background and closed-app phone acceptance is still not recorded.
tasks.nextStep: On Staging Build 14, verify saved minutes, timezone changes, first-frame planned cards and exactly one diary entry per occurrence before and after the scheduled time.

tasks.title: Coach check-in flag appears on the diary only when due

tasks.nextStep: Confirm absent before due, visible when due, and cleared after completion or skip.

tasks.title: Suggested and Recent cards arrive late when opening Search
tasks.summary: Regular Build 467 still allows cold Search support work to arrive late. Staging Build 14 retains bounded exact-context caches, migrates the older first-update cache and makes launch support work yield to a visible Search. Automated checks pass, but installed-phone timing is not yet accepted.
tasks.nextStep: After installing Staging Build 14, hard-close, reopen and immediately enter Search before today's cache can warm. Confirm Suggested and Recents paint promptly, then repeat a later hard close plus slow/offline, Timeline-hour, logout and account-switch checks.

tasks.title: Recents can disappear when Suggested is present
tasks.summary: The missing-shelf backend correction is live, but regular Build 467 can still paint personal Search sections late. Staging Build 14 gives each query one stable local Recents and My foods snapshot so server stages cannot keep adding or replacing those sections.
tasks.nextStep: On Staging Build 14, confirm Suggested and Recents appear without duplicate cards, then watch the completed screen for at least five seconds and verify neither Recents nor My foods keeps materialising or reshuffling. Repeat in another meal and time slot.

tasks.title: Verified and Branded foods stay correctly classified and unique
tasks.summary: The backend classification correction is live. Final checks of Common, Verified and Branded shelves remain.
tasks.nextStep: Check government foods in Common, reviewed products in Verified, and unreviewed products in Branded.

tasks.title: Common foods use the correct household portions
tasks.summary: Build 461 includes reviewed portion families and wording fixes. Several foods passed; remaining oat-milk, onion and macro-ring checks are open.

tasks.title: Regional product typos can miss a valid result

tasks.title: Typed Search results feel slow again
tasks.summary: Regular Build 467 and the first Staging Build 14 check were phone-proven affected. Local History and My foods appeared first while catalogue and TRAK Custom waited because staging was using its slower database fallback. The corrected staging backend now requires the Fast index at startup; live repeated probes passed its timing gate, but the phone result is not yet accepted.
tasks.nextStep: Using the existing Staging Build 14, hard-close, reopen and immediately search chicken breast. Catalogue and TRAK Custom should join the local results without the previous multi-second gap. Watch for five seconds and confirm Previously logged or My foods does not keep populating or reshuffling. Aadam owns this phone check; production needs a separate later release decision.

tasks.title: Recipes keep the same serving everywhere
tasks.summary: Regular Build 467 can reconstruct a Previously logged recipe from its diary row and lose the named serving shown in Recipes or My foods. Staging Build 14 uses one shared current-recipe projection for serving, unit, amount, nutrition and recipe identity while leaving old diary snapshots unchanged.
tasks.nextStep: On Staging Build 14, open cheesy meatloaf or another recently logged recipe through Recipes, My foods and Previously logged. Confirm the named serving, amount, unit and nutrition are identical and History does not fall back to grams; then save and reopen one new log.

tasks.title: Food projections share one source of truth
tasks.summary: An executable matrix now records which canonical food or recipe each app surface uses. Identical fixtures and cross-surface tests cover Recipes, My foods, Previously logged and AI logging, and Staging Build 14 preserves explicit AI recipe and template identity. Pinned private-food identity and recipe icon authority remain known follow-ups.
tasks.nextStep: Complete the Build 14 phone parity checks, then separately define the remaining pinned-food identity and recipe-icon authority rules before changing those paths. Keep the matrix and identical fixtures mandatory for future Search or food-model work.

tasks.title: Every daily total uses the canonical diary rule
tasks.summary: The audit confirmed the main TDEE, Coach, Roll-On and calendar paths use the intended rule: a day's entries total wins when present, otherwise active food-log rows are used. Several secondary calculations still read one pool directly, so mixed old and new history can disagree across parts of the app.
tasks.nextStep: Create one shared daily-total resolver and move the remaining trend, Insights, AI calorie-plan, remaining-macro and goal-summary consumers onto it. Add mixed-history, deletion, fasting, incomplete-day and account-isolation tests before release.
